positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented new features for a web-based freelance marketplace service, including extensive Status Reporting / Workview component, Team User feature, Portfolio revamp, Trust and Security audit, Dashboard component, and My Providers component. Features ranged in scope all the way from back-end DB access modules, through business logic layer and front-end presentation layer, to client-side Javascript/AJAX layer.

Implemented API suite for use in Mobile Application being built by 3rd party developer. Integrated with 3rd party online services, including Paypal and Salesforce, utilizing REST/SOAP APIs. Helped manage external remote developers, and managed several interns.

Architect-ed, designed, and implemented a Symfony 2/JQuery-mobile based platform for mobile web site version.

Unit tested, wrote test scripts, assisted in QA of application, fixed defects  and developed Customer Service toolset to maintain high quality of service. 

Responsible for responding to "live" issues, and was on-call for several back-end "cronjob" processes. Assisted CS team in dealing with billing issues.

Undertook many self-motivated framework development and performance tools projects, coding standards implementations, and good practice initiatives.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Sole developer for a startup building a custom Linux-based digital signage solution.
Developed an application suite for displaying MPEG2 video and static JPEG images, via multimedia projector or LCD screen, using C.
Developed a multi-tiered back-end web-based management suite with automatic content updating, automated play list creation and scheduling, and custom play reporting using Perl, MySQL, and Apache.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and developed a back-end web-based Account/STB management interface for an IPTV/Triple Play deployment, including ticketing system, calendar scheduling system, and user-customizable reporting, using Perl, MySQL, and Apache.
Managed testing, bug-reporting, and feature requests, worked closely with users to determine their needs, and handled release management, utilizing Bugzilla and CVS.
Designed and maintained MySQL database schema and DB access code, and handled importing of existing customer databases.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
Implemented feature requests and fixed bugs for an eCommerce platform that utilized Perl, MySQL, and Apache.
Worked closely with users and developed code for internal B2B website.
Maintained Perl scripts for detecting fraud, processing emails, and various other tasks.
